proof_body:
by
  intro a b h
  have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd a b := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro h0
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    omega
  refine ⟨a / Nat.gcd a b, b / Nat.gcd a b, Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd hg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b)).symm
  · exact (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b)).symm
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ), (a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) → ∃ m n : ℕ, Nat.Coprime m n ∧ a = Nat.gcd a b * m ∧ b = Nat.gcd a b * n
